predictor.notes: The observed approved prices were 59,790 cents at quantity 50 and 131,190 cents at quantity 200. This predictor is the unique affine model through those two observations: 35,990 + 476*q cents. Inspection stated that approved requests were available only for quantities 50 and 200; all six estimate/alias probes were denied, including probes at approved quantities. Eight business requests and three REA operations were used. The underlying exact rule is not identifiable from this evidence. This is a simple interpolation/extrapolation predictor, not a verified reconstruction: nonlinear terms, band boundaries, discontinuities, and prices at every other quantity remain unknown.
